picks.editorial_note: A combined $1B+ commitment from Georgia Tech and Emory is one of the largest university AI investments on record, positioning Georgia as a national AI hub and signaling how deeply institutional budgets are now being restructured around AI infrastructure.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Emory Invest More Than $1B in AI to Drive State’s Jobs, Economic Growth

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced consortium of 15 universities across 10 states pooling AI supercomputing resources represents a significant federal-academic alignment on 'super intelligence' infrastructure, with implications for how regional research capacity scales nationally.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: SLAC leading a DOE Genesis Mission project to apply autonomous AI-driven discovery to catalysis research could meaningfully accelerate breakthroughs in energy and chemical science, a flagship example of AI reshaping the scientific method itself.
picks.title: SLAC to lead a Department of Energy Genesis Mission project for Super Intelligence (SI)-driven autonomous discovery in catalysis

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's $20M NSF-funded Nexus supercomputer, opened to researchers nationwide in partnership with UIUC, expands shared national AI compute capacity at a moment when access to large-scale infrastructure is a key bottleneck for academic AI research.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Opens Supercomputer to Researchers Nationwide

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's SPIRE project to build fully autonomous self-driving laboratories, where AI agents and robots run photon-science experiments independently, is a concrete step toward a new paradigm of unattended scientific discovery.
picks.title: SLAC leads new project to build the self-driving laboratory of the future

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Phase II funding for Lawrence Berkeley's MOAT-Core project shows sustained federal commitment to applying AI in particle accelerator design, with potential downstream benefits for energy, medicine, and fundamental physics facilities.
picks.title: Super Intelligence for Particle Accelerators Gets Another Boost

picks.editorial_note: The University of Arkansas's AURORA robot-controlled AI laboratory, backed by a $20M NSF-led project, exemplifies how autonomous experimentation platforms are accelerating materials discovery timelines that once took years.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: UK AI Minister Kanishka Narayan's announcement of new government measures to guard against AI risks, delivered at Imperial College London, reflects growing regulatory momentum in the UK as AI capabilities advance.
picks.title: AI minister announces measures to protect against AI risks in speech at Imperial

picks.editorial_note: ASU's new AI Research Acceleration Platform, backed by an Intel donation, broadens equitable access to AI supercomputing for all students and researchers, a model other universities may look to replicate.
picks.title: ASU provides access to AI-supercomputing for all

picks.editorial_note: NJIT spinout OppyAI's commercialization of 'Neural Crypto,' a privacy-preserving hybrid AI technology, shows university research translating directly into deployable enterprise technology addressing real data-privacy concerns.
picks.title: NJIT Spinout OppyAI Takes Private Hybrid AI to the Global Stage
